name: Marcelo Garcia North South Choke System
description: Marcelo Garcia’s The Complete North South Choke covers alignment, grip concepts, blocking-arm problems and entries from several top positions.
summary: A focused choke course addressing alignment, defensive frames and entries from top positions.
overview: The Complete North South Choke examines Marcelo Garcia’s setup and finishing details for one submission. Alignment and grips are followed by ways of dealing with blocking arms, head turns and escapes. Entries from several top positions make it relevant to grapplers who want this choke within their existing top game.

related_content.name: Submission Clinic System
related_content.relationship: Kimura control and its connections to other positions and submissions.

products.title: The Complete North South Choke
products.blurb: Four volumes on north-south choke mechanics, defensive problems and entries.
products.best_for: Top players seeking a detailed course on one choke.

fits: You reach north-south but struggle to establish or maintain the choke.
You want entries from mount, half guard and knee on belly.

includes: Alignment, grips, elbow position and base.
Blocking-arm problems, head turns and finishing adjustments.
Entries from top positions and transitions from kimura or armbar attacks.
limits: The course concentrates on the choke; it is not a general north-south pinning or guard-passing curriculum.
